name: Warrior of the Elements

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A monk who bends the elements: strikes that reach farther and burn, freeze or shock, and bursts of raw elemental force.

feature.name: Elemental Attunement
feature.summary: Spend 1 Focus for 10 minutes of elemental strikes: +10 feet of reach, Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder damage, and a push or pull.
feature.text: At the start of your turn you can spend 1 Focus Point to fill yourself with elemental energy for 10 minutes, or until you have the Incapacitated condition. While it lasts your Unarmed Strikes reach 10 feet farther; when you hit with one, you can make its damage Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder, and you can force the target to make a Strength saving throw or be pushed or pulled up to 10 feet (your choice).

feature.name: Manipulate Elements
feature.summary: You know the Elementalism cantrip, with Wisdom as your spellcasting ability.
feature.text: You know the Elementalism spell. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for it.

feature.name: Elemental Burst
feature.summary: Magic action, 2 Focus: a 20-foot sphere within 120 feet deals three Martial Arts dice of an element (Dex save halves).
feature.text: As a Magic action you can spend 2 Focus Points to make elemental energy burst in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 120 feet of you. Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder: each creature in the sphere makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking damage of that type equal to three rolls of your Martial Arts die on a failure, or half as much on a success.

feature.name: Stride of the Elements
feature.summary: While Elemental Attunement is active you have a Fly Speed and a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

feature.name: Elemental Epitome
feature.summary: While attuned: Resistance to a chosen element, Step of the Wind damages creatures you pass, and your strikes deal extra elemental damage.
